approvers: Just me; site foreman and the developer client if they asked for it
reason: The aluminium already comes with factory film, and for the few scratches and cement splashes we get, my lads wipe it down or the glazier fixes it. Paying about €19 a m2 on top is real money on a €350k turnover, and I would have to put a new supplier and a new budget line in place for it.
objection: €19 a m2 for something I do not pay for today, when the factory film and a bit of care on site already cover most of it. I do not see the callbacks it would save.
instead: Keep the factory film, tape and cardboard where needed, and have the installer fix any damage at handover.
would_change_my_mind: A developer client who asks for it on a premium block and pays for it as a separate line, or proof from a Maltese site that it cost less than the glazing damage claims I actually get.
